args.evidence: Not_null test on fct_orders.region_name failed: 14,625 nulls out of 15,000 rows. fct_orders SQL uses `left join dim_customers c on o.order_key = c.customer_key`, which mismatches keys (order_key vs customer_key). Join result shows only 375 matches, leaving region_name null for the rest. Upstream tables raw.orders, stg_orders, dim_customers have correct data and no null region_name. The problem originates in the fct_orders model code; fixing the join to `on o.customer_key = c.customer_key` will resolve.
